next.reason: Status 10 keeps both 1985 cases: 'NEXT was specified or implied and the end of the physical file has been reached', and 'a sequential READ statement is attempted for the first time on a file described as optional and the physical file is not present' (§2023:9.1.13.4 GR1). The READ rules restate them (§2023:14.9.30.4 GR21 for the position indicator and GR24 'set to '10' to indicate the at end condition'). The PREVIOUS case needs syntax 1985 lacks.
